title: Full-Stack Engineer — AI Authoring Platform
description:
About Tracium

Tracium builds AI-assisted technical documentation software for teams working with complex manuals and engineering information. Our platform combines document intelligence with S1000D authoring, initially serving maritime use cases.

We want technical authors to spend less time managing document complexity and more time producing accurate, useful information.

Your role

You will turn our AI and document processing capabilities into a product that technical authors and engineers can use confidently. You will work across the authoring interface, backend services, and integrations.

What you’ll do

  • Build an intuitive editor that lets users create structured technical documentation without working directly with XML tags.

  • Develop interfaces for reviewing extracted information and AI suggestions alongside their sources.

  • Create workflows for editing, validation, version comparison, and document export.

  • Build backend APIs and integrate document processing and AI services.

  • Implement access controls, audit history, and reliable handling of long-running tasks.

  • Improve responsiveness and performance when working with large documents.

  • Work closely with the founders and domain experts to translate feedback into product improvements.

What you bring

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production web applications.

  • Strong TypeScript and React skills, or experience with a comparable modern frontend framework.

  • Backend development experience with Python or Node.js.

  • Experience designing APIs and working with relational databases.

  • A practical approach to testing, security, accessibility, and maintainable code.

  • An interest in making complex workflows straightforward for users.

  • Clear communication in English.

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description:
Cybersecurity Intern

Company: Sereact GmbH
Location: Stuttgart, Germany

About the role

Help us improve the security and monitoring of our cloud infrastructure and internal systems. A key project will be building and rolling out our SIEM platform for centralized security monitoring and threat detection. You’ll also work on vulnerability management and ISO 27001/SOC 2 controls, while developing security tools and automation using Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

You’ll receive technical guidance and gradually take ownership of practical security projects.

Responsibilities

  • Help build, deploy, and maintain our SIEM platform, integrating logs from cloud infrastructure, applications, identity systems, and network devices.

  • Configure monitoring dashboards, detection rules, and alerts to monitor infrastructure health and security.

  • Improve infrastructure security through access reviews, secure configurations, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Investigate alerts and support incident response.

  • Develop and maintain security automation and integrate checks into CI/CD workflows.

  • Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, audit evidence collection, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Pursuing a degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Basic knowledge of infrastructure security, networking, Linux, and SIEM
